text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... u-um...! Thank you so much for the 
other day...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Eep!? ...Which 'the other day' does she 
mean!?\nThe racetrack? The library? The 
merch shop??\nI've seen her so many times 
on-site from afar that I can't tell...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Um... Digital-san— you pre-ordered the 
same Umamusume Yearbook, didn't you...! 
Could it be... you're interested in 
Umamusume history too...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ababa, I'm sorry, no, um, YES...!! YOU'RE 
RIGHT...!! IT'S HISTORY...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Aah...! I can't say it, there's no way I 
can tell them...!! —That I only bought it 
as reference material for my writing!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I knew it...! Actually, I saw you buying 
the "Famous Umamusume Racewear Collection" 
before... and so... um.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“—You really love racing, don't you? ...I 
do too!”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(That's research material for my work 
too...!! Wait, don't tell me he saw it...! 
And with such pure, innocent eyes...?!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(What careless negligence...!! Offending 
their gaze any further is strictly 
forbidden...!! I must blend into the 
background like thin air...!!!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, she stopped breathing— Digital-san! 
Stay with us...! D-Digital-san...!!
